payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various baselines used in the study, including types of models and experimental setups.

claims.text: The baselines include a vanilla ST baseline with only a speech encoder and decoder.
Pre-training baselines consist of encoder pre-training, decoder pre-training, and encoder-decoder pre-training.
Multi-task baselines include one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many settings.
Competitive baselines were reproduced based on the ESPnet framework for fair comparison.
